questions.q: Which movement is named after a Monet painting of 1872?
questions.why: A critic mocked Monet's Impression, Sunrise, and the name stuck.

questions.q: Who painted The Third of May 1808?
questions.why: Goya painted it in 1814 as a protest against the horrors of war; it is in the Prado.

questions.q: Which technique creates depth using lines that meet at a vanishing point?
questions.why: Linear perspective developed in the Renaissance.

questions.q: Describe two ways Impressionist painters worked that were new at the time.
questions.model: They painted outdoors (en plein air) to capture changing light, and used quick, broken brushstrokes of pure colour instead of smooth blended finishes.
points: painted outdoors/plein air or captured light
visible broken brushstrokes/pure colour side by side
